name: Live readout HUD
looks: A small monospace readout in a corner keeps changing through a story beat, independent of whatever words are landing over it, such as a counter or a running pair of values. It makes the scene feel measured and alive rather than static.
build: Render the readout as a monospace DOM text block whose value is a pure function of time, such as a simple rate multiplied by elapsed time, set with no easing, and keep its contrast low enough that it never fights the main words on screen.
prompt: Under any scene built around a quantity, such as visitors, time saved or steps completed, add a small, quietly moving readout in a corner that keeps counting or updating on its own clock, independent of whatever headline copy sits over it. Keep real numbers only when they are genuinely known; otherwise mark them as illustrative samples.
source: a science explainer ("photon journey from the Sun") in prompt-motion.com's gallery, studied 2026-10-07.
